title: Kalimah Tayyibah
arabic: لا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ مُحَمَّدٌ رَّسُوْلُ اللَّهِ
translation: There is no God beses Allah; Hadhrat Muhammad (j) is the messenger of Allah.

title: Kalimah Shahaadah
arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
translation: I bear witness that there is no God beses Allah and I bear witness that Hadhrat Muhammad (j) is His servant and messenger.

title: Kalimah Tamj
arabic: سُبْحَانَ الله وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلَا اله الا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ
translation: Glory be to Allah and all praise be to Allah. There is no God beses Allah. And, Allah is the Greatest. There is no power and might except from Allah, The Most High, The Great.

title: Kalimah Tawhîd
arabic: لا اله الا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيْتُ بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
translation: There is no God beses Allah He is One. He has no partner. His is the kingdom and for Him is all praise. He gives life and causes death. In His hand is all good. And He has power over everything.

title: Kalimah Rad-de Kufr
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ أُشْرِكَ بِكَ شَيْئًا وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ بِهِ وَاسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لَا أَعْلَمُ بِهِ تُبْتُ عَنْهُ وَتَبَرَّاتُ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالشِّرْكِ وَالْمَعَاصِيْ كُلِّهَا أَسْلَمْتُ وَآمَنْتُ وَاقُوْلُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ مُحَمَّدٌ رَّسُوْلُ الله
translation: O Allah, I seek protection in You from that I should join any partner with You knowingly. I seek Your forgiveness from that which I do not know. I repent from ignorance. I free myself from disbelief and from joining partners with You, and I free myself from all sins. I submit to Your will. I believe and I declare: There is no God beses Allah and Hadhrat Muhammad j is the Messenger of Allah

title: Imâni-Mujmal
arabic: امَنْتُ باللَّهِ كَمَا هُوَ بِأَسْمَائِهِ وَصِفَاتِه وَقَبِلْتُ جَمِيعَ أَحْكَامِهِ
translation: I believe in Allah as He is understood by His names and His attributes and I accept all His orders.

title: Imâni-Mufassal
arabic: آمَنْتُ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلَئِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ وَالْقَدْرِ خَيْرِهِ وَشَرِّهِ مِنَ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَالْبَعْثِ بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ
translation: I believe in Allah, His Angels, His Books, His Messengers, the Last Day, and in Taqdîr, that all good and bad is from Allah the Most High and I believe in the resurrection after death.

title: Before eating
translation: In the name of Allah and upon the blessings of Allah.
virtue: One who reads this dua will receive blessing in one's meals

title: When forgetting to recite the dua before eating
translation: In the name of Allah in the beginning and the end.

title: After eating
arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَجَعَلَنَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
translation: All praise be to Allah who gave us food and drink and made us Muslims.
virtue: Allah becomes pleased when His slave praises Him after meals.

title: Before sleeping
translation: O Allah, with Your name do I die and live.

title: When awakening
arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
translation: All praise is due to Allah who has given us life after death and to Him is the return.

title: Before entering toilet (with left foot)
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
translation: O Allah, I seek Your protection from the male and female devil.

title: After leaving toilet (with right foot)
arabic: غُفْرَانَكَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي اذْهَبَ عَنِّي الْأَذَى وَعَافَانِي
translation: I seek Your pardon. Praise be to Allah who removed from me discomfort and granted me relief.

title: Listener's reply to sneeze
translation: May Allah have mercy on you.

title: For increase in knowledge
translation: O my Lord, increase me in knowledge.
virtue: By reciting this dua, one's memory will strengthen, InshaAllah.
